title: Calculate printing and binding costs
goal: The total cost is calculated based on the unit price per page, number of pages and one-time binding fee.
summary: The multiplication sign * calculates the cost corresponding to the number of pages, and the plus sign + adds up the costs. In expressions without parentheses changing the order, multiplication precedes addition.
tasks: Use pagePrice multiplied by pages within the curly brackets of printCost to get the printing fee, plus bindingFee once.
uses return to return the total cost. The unit price and binding fee are expressed in cents, which can be 0.
hint: The printing fee is calculated first, then the binding fee is added. If the two charges are added up and then multiplied by the number of pages, the binding fee will be charged repeatedly per page.

example.note: The meeting room needs 26 chairs for four rows and two spare chairs.
